issues.description: The UML in the problem statement declares getNumberOfStudentsPerTutor() as returning double, but the solution implementation defines getNumberOfStudentsPerTutor() with return type int. The template does not provide a signature (TODO), which means students following the UML will expect a double return type while the provided solution uses int. This mismatch can cause confusion and failing tests if the exercise or tests expect a double result (e.g., fractional students per tutor).
issues.suggestedFix: Make the return type consistent with the UML by changing the method signature to return double and performing floating-point division. For example: public double getNumberOfStudentsPerTutor() { return (double) getTotalNumberOfStudents() / getNumberOfTutors(); } Update the template and any tests/documentation accordingly so students and reference solution agree.
